ai_catalog.name: react_search_loop
ai_catalog.rough_description: Takes a multi-hop question (preset or visitor-typed) and returns an interleaved trace of short reasoning statements, the web-search queries it chose to issue, the returned snippets it observed, and a terminal result — either an answer naming the observations it rested on, or, when the cycle budget runs out, a statement of what remained unresolved.

ai_catalog.name: react_question_suitability_check
ai_catalog.rough_description: Takes a visitor's free-form question and returns an assessment of whether answering it requires chaining two or more facts and whether any hop needs live information, so the visitor is told up front whether their question will actually exercise the loop or resolve in a single step.

ai_catalog.name: hop_source_annotation
ai_catalog.rough_description: Takes a completed run trace and returns a per-hop label describing which facts the model recalled from its own knowledge versus which came from a search observation, with a brief note on why.
